verdict.rationale: Gusto's own company-news page says it guides business owners through registering for a federal EIN as part of a single guided formation flow. The same page says these capabilities are in early beta and will roll out to more entrepreneurs over the coming months, so availability is limited and unproven. Missing for 10: general availability beyond early beta, detailed documentation of how the EIN is obtained (whether Gusto files with the IRS or only guides the user), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can obtain a federal EIN for my new company through the platform

citations.quote: Gusto guides business owners through registering for a federal EIN as part of the same flow.
